instruction.text: Replace the word in blue with the correct pronoun.

atoms.a: Jack has been training a lot over summer. <t-blue>Jack</t-blue> is now the best player on the team.
atoms.b: Jack has been training a lot over summer. ((He)) is the best player on the team.

atoms.a: I’m not sure when the party is, but Ellie will know. You should ask <t-blue>Ellie</t-blue>.
atoms.b: I’m not sure when the party is, but Ellie will know. You should ask ((her)).

atoms.a: That teddy is not Lola’s. <t-blue>Lola</t-blue> borrowed <t-blue>the teddy</t-blue> from her sister.
atoms.b: That teddy is not Lola’s. ((She)) borrowed ((it)) from her sister.
